props.name: Hi, I'm Alex
props.bio: I design and build calm, useful software. Currently focused on developer tools and design systems.

props.title: About
props.content: For the last 8 years I've helped startups turn fuzzy ideas into products people actually enjoy using. I move comfortably between Figma and the codebase, which means fewer things get lost in translation. I care about the job the user is hiring the product to do — and about shipping.

props.title: Check out my latest work
